cardOverview.overviewText: A Monthly Treats card rewarding everyday shopping, dining, and utilities with milestone vouchers, designed for regular spenders.

benefitRows.name: BookMyShow
benefitRows.offer: 10% instant discount up to INR 300 per month on BookMyShow.|Avail this benefit on the BookMyShow app/website.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this offer, visit the BookMyShow website or app.|Select your movie, date, time, and seats.|Proceed to payment and find the offers/discounts section.|Select the applicable bank discount offer and enter your card details.|Complete the payment to get the Offer.

benefitRows.name: Mynta
benefitRows.offer: Enjoy 10% cashback on Myntra on top of any discounts you receive in this app.|Max cashback capped at INR 900 per calendar month, with a limit of INR 300 for each brand.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, shop on the Myntra app or website using your RBL Monthly Treats credit card. Enjoy 10% cashback on top of other discounts, capped at ₹900 per calendar month and ₹300 per brand. For assistance, contact RBL Bank customer care at 1860 123 4455.
